seoTitle: Transfer a Domain to GoDaddy from Any Registrar
metaDescription: Move a domain to GoDaddy from any registrar, including Namecheap. Learn how to unlock it, get the EPP/Auth code, and check for free transfer offers.
intro: Transferring a domain from any registrar to GoDaddy generally follows the same core process: unlock the domain, retrieve the authorization code, and initiate the transfer. This guide covers those steps along with checking whether your domain extension qualifies for a free transfer offer.

steps.heading: Unlock your domain at the current registrar
steps.body: Log in to your current registrar and disable the domain lock so it becomes eligible to be transferred elsewhere.

steps.heading: Get the EPP/Auth code from your current registrar
steps.body: Request the authorization code, which GoDaddy will use to verify and initiate the transfer on your behalf.

steps.heading: Initiate the domain transfer on GoDaddy
steps.body: Log in to GoDaddy, start a new transfer request, and enter your domain along with the EPP/Auth code.

steps.heading: Check for free transfer eligibility
steps.body: Some domain extensions may qualify for a free transfer, so check GoDaddy's current offers before completing the process.

steps.heading: Track the transfer status
steps.body: Monitor the transfer progress in your GoDaddy dashboard until it confirms the domain has fully moved over, watching for and resolving any common errors along the way.

faq.question: Does this process work for domains from any registrar?
faq.answer: Yes, the general steps apply broadly, including transfers from registrars like Namecheap, though exact screens may differ.

faq.question: Are all domain transfers to GoDaddy free?
faq.answer: No, only certain domain extensions may qualify for free transfer promotions, so it's worth checking current offers.

faq.question: What common errors can happen during a transfer?
faq.answer: Issues often relate to an incorrect EPP/Auth code, a domain still being locked, or the domain not meeting the minimum registration age for transfer.

faq.question: How long does the transfer usually take?
faq.answer: Most domain transfers take around five to seven days to fully complete once initiated.
